title: Obsidian Trustline
text:
Obsidian Trustline

notes:
• Org profile: mid-to-large healthcare payments provider handling patient billing + card payments. Heavy compliance: PCI + HIPAA.
• Primary asks: agent assist (real-time suggestions, snippets), automated ticket summarization for post-call notes, tool-calling to CRM & payment gateway (chargebacks, CVV checks), and robust fallback routing during claim-processing spikes.
• Latency/throughput: need <200ms p95 for agent-assist; sustain 500 concurrent agents with 2k TPS during peak batch windows (end of month claims).
• Security: must run in customer VPC with private control plane; keys in HSM (customer-managed); audit logs immutable for 7 years; SSO via SAML + SCIM user sync; data residency: US-East only; strict DLP rules — no PHI/PII to third-party telemetry.
• Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for Private + Dedicated SLA for stability during spikes, but asks for Optimize recommendations to reduce token costs (prefix caching, quantized model suggestions).
• Integration notes: telephony via Twilio — need PCI scope confirmation; CRM = Salesforce Service Cloud with tool-calling APIs; Single-click escalation to human agent must preserve audit trail.
• Quote from Head of Support (M. Alvarez): "We cannot have any PHI leakage — even metadata. Audit trail is not optional."
• POC goals: validate 1) VPC private control plane + HSM KMS workflow, 2) sub-200ms agent-assist with caching, 3) deterministic fallback to a smaller quantized model under load, 4) end-to-end audit log generation and export.
• Risk: legal team may push for on-prem export for backups; telephony vendor's PCI posture unknown — will likely need joint assessment.
• Internal quick wins: enable prefix caching for agent prompts; test sampling-based summarization to reduce token usage; suggest quantized model for rerank/fallback path.
• Sales notes: Obsidian is referenceable if SOC2 + PCI artefacts provided and POC meets spike SLOs.

timeline:
2025-11-04 - Initial inbound via marketplace form (Maya) — labeled healthcare-payments; asked for PCI + PHI support
2025-11-18 - Intro call (Maya, Jordan) — high-level reqs: 500 concurrent agents, <200ms agent-assist p95, 7yr retention for transcripts
2025-12-02 - Security questionnaire provided by Obsidian (Drive link). They insist on HSM-backed keys and explicit KMS integration
2026-01-14 - Proof-of-concept (POC) scope drafted: VPC private plane, Twilio connector, Genesys lift-and-shift path; Redwood to demo canary/fallback routing
2026-02-11 - Technical deep-dive (Jordan, Infra Eng, Obsidian SecOps) — discussed KV cache eviction, batching windows, and spike handling (claims cycle peaks)
2026-03-03 - Security deep-dive follow-up (Anika joined) — legal requested PCI scope diagram and audit log retention policy
2026-03-06 - Pre-POC checklist reviewed; identified timeline for HSM cert and SOC2 evidence upload

next_step:
POC kickoff in VPC (week of 2026-03-15) — finalize HSM/KMS integration checklist

blockers:
legal review for long-term retention (7+ years)
PCI scope confirmation with telephony provider (Twilio/GI) 
on-prem agent for air-gapped batch exports
